character.description: Baro, mature talking badger antiques dealer. Gray-brown fur, dark markings from eyes to snout, tiny round ears, broad torso, short legs and short tail. Animal paws with short claws. Dusty red short vest, blue-gray belly apron, small round spectacles, blank price tag bundle in apron pocket. Standing on hind paws, one forepaw open as if explaining. No human hands, pants, shoes or long tail; not a baby.

idle.action: Gentle belly breathing and blink, standing on short hind paws. Seamless cycle.

danger.action: Lean forward with concerned look and hold apron edges. Subtle seamless cycle.

success.action: Open one forepaw in a pleased presenting gesture, then settle.

garbage-land.action: Brief startle and bracing with both forepaws, then steady himself.

victory.action: Rub the two forepaws together with a pleased smile, finish with paws together.

defeat.action: Remove spectacles and gently wipe them with apron, finish subdued holding glasses. Keep glasses connected to paws, no detached items.

finish.action: Adjust spectacles and relax into a friendly satisfied pose.

style: Detailed pixel-style 2D sprite, crisp outlines and restrained shading, preserve reference details
